description: Detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PL-122 BG-01 Received: 28 February 2019; PL-122 BG-02 (Rev A) Received: 18 April 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The building hereby approved shall be constructed in red sand-faced brickwork and red roof tiles.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding shall only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the house at 122 Bassett Gardens as described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (e.g. it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain bedroom, kitchen, living room or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes unless a separate Certificate of Lawfulness has been sought and obtained for the specific use).
Condition : 5 - No further windows and doors shall be formed in the rear and side elevations of the outbuilding.
